outcome: treatment failure (defined as needing surgical intervention for retained product of conception)
cohort: Patients who received medical treatment for early pregnancy loss between 2016 and 2023 at a single medical center.
finding: The addition of mifepristone to misoprostol was associated with a significantly lower rate of treatment failure for early pregnancy loss compared with misoprostol alone.
mod_finding: Prior vaginal delivery was associated with a lower risk for treatment failure.
followup_time: Until after menstruation or resolution of retained product of conception
